genes.name: Nucleotide-Binding Oligomerization Domain Containing 2 (CARD15)
genes.function: Intracellular pattern recognition receptor sensing muramyl dipeptide (MDP); activates NF-κB and autophagy pathways critical for Paneth cell function and antimicrobial peptide secretion
genes.ibd_evidence: Three common variants (R702W, G908R, L1007fsinsC) confer the strongest genetic risk for Crohn's disease. Homozygosity or compound heterozygosity increases CD risk 20-40 fold. L1007fsinsC frameshift abolishes MDP sensing and NF-κB activation. Not associated with UC.

genes.name: Autophagy Related 16 Like 1
genes.function: Essential component of the autophagy machinery; regulates autophagosome formation, Paneth cell granule exocytosis, and clearance of intracellular bacteria
genes.ibd_evidence: T300A (rs2241880) coding variant is a major CD risk allele (OR 1.3-1.5). The T300A variant is cleaved by caspase-3, impairing autophagy and bacterial clearance in the gut epithelium. Also associated with defective Paneth cell morphology.

genes.name: Interleukin-23 Receptor
genes.function: Receptor subunit for IL-23; pairs with IL12RB1 to drive Th17 cell expansion, IL-17/IL-22 production, and intestinal inflammation
genes.ibd_evidence: R381Q (rs11209026) is a protective variant reducing IL-23R signaling (OR 0.3-0.6 for both CD and UC). Multiple other variants confer modest risk. IL-23R is a key therapeutic target validated by ustekinumab, risankizumab, and mirikizumab efficacy.

genes.name: Immunity Related GTPase M
genes.function: GTPase regulating autophagy-mediated clearance of intracellular pathogens including adherent-invasive E. coli (AIEC) frequently isolated from CD ileal mucosa
genes.ibd_evidence: rs13361189 and rs10065172 upstream deletion polymorphisms alter IRGM expression. Associated specifically with Crohn's disease. IRGM-dependent autophagy controls AIEC replication in macrophages.

genes.name: Leucine-Rich Repeat Kinase 2
genes.function: Multi-domain kinase and GTPase regulating autophagy, lysosomal function, and inflammatory cytokine production in myeloid cells and Paneth cells
genes.ibd_evidence: rs11564258 (M2397T) and other coding variants associated with CD risk. LRRK2 is highly expressed in immune cells and intestinal epithelium. LRRK2 kinase activity promotes NF-κB signaling.

genes.name: TNF Superfamily Member 15 (TL1A)
genes.function: Cytokine ligand for DR3 (TNFRSF25); co-stimulates Th1 and Th17 effector cells and promotes mucosal inflammation and fibrosis
genes.ibd_evidence: TNFSF15 polymorphisms strongly associated with CD in multiple populations. TL1A is elevated in inflamed CD mucosa and drives IFN-gamma and IL-17 production. Associated with stricturing and penetrating CD phenotypes. Also linked to UC.

genes.name: Interleukin-10
genes.function: Key anti-inflammatory cytokine produced by Tregs, macrophages, and B cells; suppresses IL-12, IL-23, and TNF production; essential for intestinal immune homeostasis
genes.ibd_evidence: IL10 polymorphisms and promoter haplotypes associated with both CD and UC. IL-10-deficient mice develop spontaneous colitis. IL-10 prevents excessive inflammation to gut microbiota.

genes.name: Interleukin-10 Receptor Alpha
genes.function: Ligand-binding subunit of the IL-10 receptor; signals through STAT3 to mediate IL-10 anti-inflammatory effects in intestinal myeloid cells and epithelium
genes.ibd_evidence: Loss-of-function mutations in IL10RA cause very-early-onset IBD (VEO-IBD) in infants. Common polymorphisms associated with adult-onset UC and CD. IL10RA/IL10RB deficiencies cause severe, treatment-refractory enterocolitis.

genes.name: Protein Tyrosine Phosphatase N22 (LYP)
genes.function: Negative regulator of T cell receptor and B cell receptor signaling; alters immune tolerance thresholds
genes.ibd_evidence: R620W (rs2476601) gain-of-function variant associated with Crohn's disease (OR 1.3). Same allele also linked to RA, T1D, and SLE. Alters TCR signaling and Treg function in intestinal mucosa.

genes.name: Signal Transducer and Activator of Transcription 3
genes.function: Transcription factor mediating IL-6, IL-10, IL-22, and IL-23 signaling; critical for Th17 differentiation and epithelial barrier repair
genes.ibd_evidence: STAT3 polymorphisms associated with both CD and UC. Gain-of-function STAT3 mutations cause early-onset lymphoproliferation and IBD. STAT3 integrates pro-inflammatory (IL-6/IL-23) and anti-inflammatory (IL-10) signals in the gut.

genes.name: Janus Kinase 2
genes.function: Non-receptor tyrosine kinase coupling cytokine receptors (IL-6R, IL-12R, IL-23R, GM-CSFR) to STAT3/STAT4 activation; drives intestinal inflammatory gene programs
genes.ibd_evidence: JAK2 polymorphisms associated with both CD and UC. JAK2 is a critical signaling hub for multiple IBD-relevant cytokines. Therapeutic JAK inhibitors (tofacitinib, upadacitinib) block JAK2-dependent signaling.

genes.name: Interleukin-12 Subunit Beta (p40)
genes.function: Shared p40 subunit of IL-12 (p35/p40) and IL-23 (p19/p40); essential for Th1 and Th17 differentiation; bridges innate and adaptive immunity
genes.ibd_evidence: IL12B polymorphisms associated with both CD and UC. The p40 subunit is the therapeutic target of ustekinumab. IL12B variants alter IL-12/IL-23 cytokine production and Th1/Th17 balance.

genes.name: Caspase Recruitment Domain Family Member 9
genes.function: Adaptor protein downstream of dectin-1 and other C-type lectin receptors; activates NF-κB and MAPK pathways in response to fungal and bacterial recognition
genes.ibd_evidence: CARD9 polymorphisms strongly associated with both CD and UC. CARD9 mediates innate immune responses to gut fungi (mycobiome). CARD9-deficient mice show altered gut microbiota and increased susceptibility to colitis.

genes.name: NK2 Homeobox 3
genes.function: Transcription factor regulating lymphocyte trafficking, spleen development, and MAdCAM-1 expression in gut endothelial cells
genes.ibd_evidence: NKX2-3 polymorphisms associated with both CD and UC across multiple GWAS. Regulates expression of MAdCAM-1, the ligand for α4β7 integrin targeted by vedolizumab. Links lymphocyte homing to IBD pathogenesis.

genes.name: Macrophage Stimulating 1 (MSP/HGFL)
genes.function: Hepatocyte growth factor-like protein; binds RON receptor tyrosine kinase to regulate macrophage function, epithelial repair, and intestinal wound healing
genes.ibd_evidence: MST1 polymorphisms associated with both CD and UC. MSP-RON signaling promotes intestinal epithelial wound healing and anti-inflammatory macrophage polarization. Impaired signaling may delay mucosal recovery.

genes.name: Fucosyltransferase 2 (Secretor Status)
genes.function: Determines ABO(H) blood group antigen expression on intestinal mucosa; controls composition of gut microbiota through mucosal glycan modification
genes.ibd_evidence: Non-secretor status (FUT2 G428A nonsense variant) is protective against Crohn's disease (OR 0.7-0.8). FUT2 genotype influences intestinal microbial composition, particularly Bacteroides and Firmicutes abundance.

genes.name: Hepatocyte Nuclear Factor 4 Alpha
genes.function: Nuclear receptor transcription factor regulating intestinal epithelial cell differentiation, tight junction integrity, and mucosal barrier function
genes.ibd_evidence: HNF4A polymorphisms associated with UC. HNF4A maintains expression of claudins, occludin, and other tight junction proteins. Loss of HNF4A in mice causes increased intestinal permeability and spontaneous colitis.

genes.name: C-C Chemokine Receptor 6
genes.function: Chemokine receptor for CCL20; directs Th17 cells, Tregs, and dendritic cells to intestinal Peyer's patches and inflamed mucosa
genes.ibd_evidence: CCR6 polymorphisms associated with CD. CCL20 is upregulated in inflamed IBD mucosa, recruiting CCR6+ Th17 cells that produce IL-17 and IL-22. CCR6-CCL20 axis is a potential therapeutic target.

genes.name: SMAD Family Member 3
genes.function: Intracellular mediator of TGF-beta signaling; regulates Treg induction, Th17/Treg balance, and intestinal fibrosis
genes.ibd_evidence: SMAD3 polymorphisms associated with both CD and UC. SMAD3 mediates TGF-beta-driven Treg differentiation while opposing Th17 polarization. Impaired SMAD3 signaling may promote intestinal fibrosis in CD stricturing disease.

genes.name: Solute Carrier Family 22 Member 5 (OCTN2)
genes.function: High-affinity carnitine transporter essential for fatty acid oxidation and mitochondrial function in intestinal epithelial cells
genes.ibd_evidence: SLC22A5 variants in the IBD5 risk haplotype (with IRF1, IL5, IL13) associated with Crohn's disease (OR 1.3). OCTN2 polymorphisms may impair butyrate and carnitine metabolism in colonic epithelium.

genes.name: Tyrosine Kinase 2
genes.function: JAK family kinase mediating type I IFN, IL-12, and IL-23 receptor signaling; essential for Th1 and Th17 responses
genes.ibd_evidence: TYK2 polymorphisms associated with both CD and UC. Protective loss-of-function variant (P1104A) reduces IL-12/IL-23 signaling and is associated with decreased IBD risk. TYK2 shares genetic risk with psoriasis and SLE.

genes.name: Inducible T Cell Costimulator Ligand (B7-H2)
genes.function: Costimulatory ligand on antigen-presenting cells and intestinal epithelium; binds ICOS on T cells to regulate Tfh and Th17 responses
genes.ibd_evidence: ICOSLG polymorphisms associated with both CD and UC. ICOS-ICOSLG interaction drives T follicular helper responses and germinal center formation in gut-associated lymphoid tissue. Elevated ICOSLG expression in inflamed IBD mucosa.

genes.name: Interleukin-17A
genes.function: Signature Th17 cytokine; drives mucosal inflammation
genes.ibd_evidence: Elevated in IBD mucosa. Complex protective/pathogenic roles.

genes.name: Calcineurin (PPP3CA / Protein Phosphatase 3)
genes.function: Calcium/calmodulin-dependent serine/threonine phosphatase; dephosphorylates NFAT enabling T cell activation
genes.disease_evidence: Target of voclosporin and tacrolimus for lupus nephritis; also stabilizes podocyte actin cytoskeleton in kidney.

genes.name: DHFR
genes.function: Methotrexate inhibits dihydrofolate reductase and AICAR transformylase, leading to adenosine accumulation with anti-inflammatory effects
genes.disease_evidence: Curated relationship endpoint for graph integrity.

genes.name: Glucocorticoid Receptor (NR3C1)
genes.function: Budesonide activates the glucocorticoid receptor with high topical potency and ~90% first-pass hepatic metabolism, minimizing systemic exposure
genes.disease_evidence: Curated relationship endpoint for graph integrity.

genes.name: IL12B (p40)
genes.function: Ustekinumab binds the shared p40 subunit of IL-12 and IL-23, simultaneously blocking both Th1 and Th17 pathways
genes.disease_evidence: Curated relationship endpoint for graph integrity.

genes.name: IL23A (p19)
genes.function: Risankizumab selectively neutralizes the IL-23-specific p19 subunit, blocking Th17/ILC3 responses while preserving IL-12-driven Th1 immunity
genes.disease_evidence: Curated relationship endpoint for graph integrity.

genes.name: ITGA4 (α4 Integrin)
genes.function: Natalizumab blocks α4 integrin, preventing both α4β1-VCAM-1 (systemic) and α4β7-MAdCAM-1 (gut) lymphocyte adhesion; restricted due to PML risk
genes.disease_evidence: Curated relationship endpoint for graph integrity.

genes.name: Janus Kinase 1
genes.function: Tyrosine kinase mediating signaling for type I/II cytokine receptors
genes.disease_evidence: Required for IFN-α/β, IL-6, and other proinflammatory cytokine signaling. Target of baricitinib and tofacitinib in SLE trials.

genes.name: JAK1/JAK3
genes.function: Tofacitinib preferentially inhibits JAK1 and JAK3, blocking signaling downstream of common gamma chain cytokines, type I IFN, and IL-6 family receptors
genes.disease_evidence: Curated relationship endpoint for graph integrity.

genes.name: PPAR-gamma
genes.function: Mesalamine activates PPAR-gamma in colonic epithelial cells, inhibiting NF-κB and COX-2 pathways with topical anti-inflammatory effects
genes.disease_evidence: Curated relationship endpoint for graph integrity.

genes.name: Purine Metabolism
genes.function: Azathioprine is a prodrug converted to 6-TGN, which incorporates into DNA and inhibits de novo purine synthesis in proliferating lymphocytes
genes.disease_evidence: Curated relationship endpoint for graph integrity.

genes.name: S1PR1/S1PR4/S1PR5
genes.function: Etrasimod is an S1PR1/4/5 modulator with S1PR3 sparing; prevents lymphocyte egress from lymphoid organs into the gut without bradycardia risk
genes.disease_evidence: Curated relationship endpoint for graph integrity.

genes.name: S1PR1/S1PR5
genes.function: Ozanimod is an S1P receptor modulator selective for S1PR1 and S1PR5; induces S1PR1 internalization, sequestering lymphocytes in lymph nodes
genes.disease_evidence: Curated relationship endpoint for graph integrity.

genes.name: TNF
genes.function: Infliximab binds soluble and membrane-bound TNF with high affinity, inducing apoptosis of TNF-expressing immune cells via Fc-mediated CDC and ADCC
genes.disease_evidence: Curated relationship endpoint for graph integrity.

genes.name: α4β7 Integrin (ITGA4/ITGB7)
genes.function: Vedolizumab selectively blocks α4β7 integrin binding to MAdCAM-1 on gut endothelial cells, preventing lymphocyte homing to intestinal mucosa
genes.disease_evidence: Curated relationship endpoint for graph integrity.
